prompts.bodyRigAtlasPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production CUTOUT ANIMATION LAYER SHEET, using the attached original star fox only as character/style reference.
We need the SAME fine painterly/anime illustration quality, detailed orange fur strands, rich amber eyes, navy robe with delicate gold constellation embroidery, ivory Chinese collar shirt, gold and silver star medallion. Do NOT simplify into a flat cartoon, toy, 3D render, emoji or a different character.
Create FOUR SEPARATE transparent components in a precise 2x2 grid, with large transparent gutters, no overlapping between cells and no labels:
TOP LEFT: the fox's complete HEAD, ears, hair and a short cream neck, absolutely FRONT-FACING, LEVEL, symmetric upright neutral pose. Both eyes open, relaxed mouth. No head tilt, no hand, no shoulder or body. Keep beautiful detailed amber eyes and fur; simple gentle closed mouth.
TOP RIGHT: the character's FRONT-FACING UPPER TORSO ONLY from high collar down through the waist, with ivory shirt, navy constellation-embroidered robe panels, star medallion and belt. NO HEAD and NO ARMS, NO HANDS. Full collar and garment behind shoulders, fill in covered cloth so the torso can stand alone under moving arms.
BOTTOM LEFT: ONE detached COMPLETE ROBED ARM for the viewer's left side, viewed from the front, shoulder at top, elbow midway, cuff and wrist at bottom. Natural down-hanging pose, almost straight. Navy constellation-embroidered full sleeve, ivory cuff; end at a small cream fur wrist stump, NO HAND attached. Give the sleeve a full round overlapping shoulder cap so it rotates cleanly. Its lighting and texture match the torso.
BOTTOM RIGHT: the corresponding detached complete sleeve ARM for the viewer's right side, mirrored matching counterpart. Shoulder at top, elbow midway, cuff and wrist at bottom; no hand.
Every component fully inside its own equal quadrant, padded transparent margins. True transparent background, not a checkerboard painting. No props, NO WAND, no hand at chin. This is a rig-ready parts layout, not a poster or assembled character. Each arm must be independent of the torso. Keep all original costume richness.
prompts.bodyRigAtlasCleanPrompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Edit target: the attached FOUR-PART star fox animation layer sheet. Keep the precise position, size, colors, painterly detail and design of the four parts unchanged.
REMOVE ALL BACKGROUND PIXELS including EVERY brown glow, grey gradient, dark field and ambient haze. The gaps and outside areas must be genuine alpha transparency, not black, grey, white, checkerboard or shadows. Sharp clean painted silhouette edges. Do not damage fine fur tips.
In the TOP RIGHT quadrant only, remove the two long arms/sleeves that are hanging attached to the torso; keep just the central torso with collar, navy front panels, star badge, shirt and belt. Restore garment underneath where arms overlapped so the body is a complete independent sleeveless torso. The detached arm components in the two bottom quadrants must remain unchanged.
Top-left head is level and front-facing, preserve it exactly. No hands, props, text or labels. Exact same image dimensions and quadrant locations.
prompts.bodyRigHandPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent HAND SPRITE ATLAS for the exact star fox character in the reference. Preserve rich anime/painterly original detail, golden orange fox fur, soft cream fur at the wrist, fine warm shading and dark brown tiny nails. Not flat cartoon or 3D.
One image with THREE equal columns, each with ONE detached anthropomorphic fox hand/paw, five believable fingers, wrist at the BOTTOM and fingers pointing UP, viewed from the PALM SIDE at the SAME scale and angle, same wrist-center anchor.
LEFT column: relaxed open palm, five gently spread digits, suitable for a wave.
CENTER column: pointing hand, index finger extended upward, other three fingers folded naturally with thumb resting over them.
RIGHT column: gently closed fist, thumb correctly resting outside curled fingers.
The hands are for the viewer's left arm, with thumb toward the center/right; we will mirror the sprites for the other side. Short cream-fur wrist stump, NO arm, sleeve or object. Full hand silhouettes inside each column with generous transparent padding and consistent wrist height. Truly transparent background: no gradient, glow, background color, shadow, checkerboard, letters, captions or grid.
